verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a re-authorise-account-consent endpoint explicitly for when a previously AUTHORIZED consent 'can no longer be used to retrieve data', letting users re-consent without starting a fresh integration. However, there's no documented status taxonomy for expired/revoked links, no explicit ops-facing dashboard or webhook event naming these states, and no equivalent documented re-auth flow for payments consents. missing for 10: documented consent status codes (expired/revoked/failed) surfaced to ops, webhook event types for consent expiry/revocation, an equivalent re-auth update flow for payment authorisations, and independent/hands-on confirmation this works smoothly in practice.
